title_zh: 中国资本市场风格漂移：追热还是寻值？

authors: Yaojie Wu, Yue Hu, Donghua Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Fund managers may adjust portfolio styles to pursue short-term private benefits, with implications for investor welfare and market stability. Using a sample of 3,243 Chinese equity-oriented mutual funds from 2012 to 2022, this paper examines the determinants and performance consequences of style drift by separating two behaviours: self-drift, defined as intertemporal variation in a fund’s style relative to its own history, and benchmark-drift, defined as deviation from the prospectus-stated style. This paper shows that self-drift is associated with two distinct motives—hot-chasing by underperforming funds and value-seeking by top performers—while benchmark-drift is predominantly driven by hot-chasing among underperformers. Consistent with these channels, the link between self-drift and future performance hinges on past performance, whereas benchmark-drift is followed by markedly lower future returns. Further evidence indicates that compensation incentives, rather than career concerns, are the primary driver of style drift. Although investors can distinguish the two forms, they disproportionately allocate capital to self-drift funds, suggesting limited recognition of their heterogeneous underlying motives. abstract_zh: 基金经理可能为了追求短期私人利益而调整投资组合风格，这对投资者福利和市场稳定性具有重要影响。本文以2012年至2022年间3，243只中国股票型共同基金为样本，通过区分两种行为——自我漂移（定义为基金风格相对于自身历史的时间变化）和基准漂移（定义为偏离招募说明书所述风格）——考察了风格漂移的决定因素及其业绩后果。研究发现，自我漂移与两种不同的动机相关——业绩不佳基金的追逐热点行为和顶尖基金的寻求价值行为——而基准漂移则主要由业绩不佳者的追逐热点行为驱动。与这些渠道一致，自我漂移与未来业绩之间的关系取决于过往业绩，而基准漂移之后则伴随着显著较低的未来回报。进一步证据表明，薪酬激励而非职业担忧是风格漂移的主要驱动因素。尽管投资者能够区分这两种形式，但他们将资本不成比例地配置给自我漂移基金，这表明投资者对其异质性潜在动机的认知有限。关键词：自我漂移 基准漂移 追逐热点 寻求价值 基金业绩 JEL分类：G11 G23 G41

official: 官方在线 2026-08-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how the US-China trade war reshaped supply chains across the Asia-Pacific region. Using newly constructed product-level input–output linkages from Chinese customs transactions, we trace how US tariffs on downstream Chinese exports propagated across borders and production stages. We document that US tariffs significantly reduced Chinese exports to the US and, through upstream linkages, caused a 6.8% decline in China’s imports from Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan. Furthermore, both China and the US reoriented parts of their supply chains toward alternative economies, especially ASEAN, but also Mexico and India. A quantitative Armington model shows that these adjustments generated heterogeneous welfare effects across countries: downstream economies such as ASEAN, Mexico, and India gained, whereas upstream suppliers such as Taiwan and South Korea incurred losses. We further show that, under a broader 2025 tariff escalation with retaliation, world trade contracts and welfare declines in all countries.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中美贸易战如何重塑亚太地区的供应链格局。利用中国海关交易数据构建的全新产品层面投入产出关联，我们追溯了美国对中国下游出口商品加征关税如何跨越国界与生产阶段进行传导。研究发现，美国关税显著减少了中国对美出口，并通过上游关联效应，导致中国从日本、韩国及台湾地区的进口下降了6.8%。此外，中国与美国均将部分供应链转向其他经济体，尤其是东盟国家，同时也包括墨西哥和印度。一个量化的阿明顿模型显示，这些调整在不同国家间产生了异质性的福利效应：下游经济体如东盟、墨西哥和印度获益，而上游供应方如台湾和韩国则遭受损失。我们进一步表明，在2025年更广泛的关税升级及报复措施情境下，全球贸易收缩，所有国家的福利均出现下降。

abstract: Economic historians have long placed culture at the centre of the rise of the West, but have lacked a measure of culture spanning the emergence of modern growth. Using 23,064 historical books, this column constructs an ‘innovation wedge’ that separates the values texts endorse from the social arrangements they merely depict. The wedge falls by 51% between 1000 and 1920. In a calibrated growth model, that decline accounts for about two-thirds of the first sustained acceleration in productivity growth between 1500 and 1700.
abstract_zh: 经济史学家长期以来将文化置于西方崛起之核心，但一直缺乏一种能够跨越现代增长兴起的文化度量。本文利用23,064本历史书籍，构建了一个“创新楔子”，用以区分文本所推崇的价值观与仅作为描绘对象的社会安排。该楔子在1000年至1920年间下降了51%。在一个校准的增长模型中，这一下降解释了1500年至1700年间生产率增长首次持续加速的大约三分之二。

title: Climate-policy pathways reshape cropland-expansion-driven deforestation and agricultural-carbon trade-off imbalance in the Amazon

title_secondary: Climate-policy pathways reshape cropland-expansion-driven deforestation and agricultural-carbon trade-off imbalance in the Amazon
authors: Wencang Shen, Zhengfeng Zhang, Walter Timo de Vries, Yuanyuan Yang, He Gao 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Urbanization, population growth and agricultural commodity demand increasingly shift land-use pressure toward distant rural frontiers, intensifying cropland expansion into tropical forests and creating substantial trade-offs between agricultural production and carbon-sink capacity. Yet where regional climate-policy land-demand pathways translate into forest-conversion risk, and how these risks overlap with agricultural-value and carbon-sink outcomes at fine spatial resolution, remains insufficiently quantified. We couple the Global Change Assessment Model (GCAM) with the Future Land Use Simulation (FLUS) model to assess cropland-expansion-driven deforestation in South America from 1992 to 2050, with the Amazon basin as the focal analytical region, under reference and 1.5 °C -consistent (1p5) pathways. We estimate agricultural value using a data-driven approach and quantify carbon impacts as changes in vegetation carbon-sink capacity. From 1992–2020, Amazon cropland increased by 2.12 × 105 km2 while forests declined by 3.51 × 105 km2, accounting for more than 60% of South America forest loss. Under the reference pathway, forest loss reaches 8.23 × 105 km2, including 1.10 × 105 km2 converted to cropland, causing an annual loss of 1.04 × 1010 kg of forest carbon sequestration while generating 4.79 × 108 GK$ in agricultural revenue. Under the 1p5 pathway, Amazon forest-to-cropland conversion declines to 7.00 × 103 km2, a 93.6% reduction relative to the reference pathway, and the net land-conversion effect shifts toward a carbon-sink gain. These results indicate an asymmetric agriculture-carbon trade-off, in which cropland expansion produces relatively limited agricultural-value gains while imposing large carbon-sink costs. The GCAM-FLUS framework identifies where such trade-offs are spatially concentrated and where mitigation-consistent land-demand pathways may reduce conversion risk. These policy implications should be interpreted together with local governance, tenure and supply-chain conditions, which are not directly simulated in the present modelling framework.
abstract_zh: 城市化、人口增长和农业商品需求日益将土地利用压力转向偏远的农村前沿地区，加剧了热带森林地区的耕地扩张，并在农业生产与碳汇能力之间产生了显著的权衡关系。然而，区域气候政策下的土地需求路径在何处转化为森林转换风险，以及这些风险如何在精细空间分辨率上与农业价值和碳汇结果重叠，仍未得到充分量化。我们将全球变化评估模型（GCAM）与未来土地利用模拟（FLUS）模型相结合，评估1992年至2050年间南美洲由耕地扩张驱动的森林砍伐，以亚马逊流域为焦点分析区域，并分别考虑参考路径和与1.5°C目标一致（1p5）的路径。我们采用数据驱动方法估算农业价值，并将碳影响量化为植被碳汇能力的变化。1992年至2020年间，亚马逊地区耕地增加了2.12×10⁵平方公里，而森林减少了3.51×10⁵平方公里，占南美洲森林损失的60%以上。在参考路径下，森林损失达到8.23×10⁵平方公里，其中1.10×10⁵平方公里转为耕地，导致森林碳汇年损失1.04×10¹⁰千克，同时产生4.79×10⁸ GK$的农业收入。在1p5路径下，亚马逊地区森林转耕地面积降至7.00×10³平方公里，较参考路径减少93.6%，净土地转换效应转向碳汇增益。这些结果表明存在不对称的农业-碳权衡关系，即耕地扩张带来的农业价值增益相对有限，却造成巨大的碳汇成本。GCAM-FLUS框架识别了此类权衡在空间上的集中区域，以及符合减缓目标的地需求路径可能在何处降低转换风险。这些政策启示应与地方治理、土地权属和供应链条件结合解读，而这些因素未在本建模框架中直接模拟。

title: Financial Shocks in Currency Markets: Evidence from UIP Premia

authors: Ece Ozge Emeksiz & Andres Fernandez & Nikhil Patel & Ivan Petrella & Tatjana Schulze
official: 官方在线 2026-07-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper proposes a sign-narrative VAR approach to identifying financial shocks in currency markets. The approach imposes minimal sign restrictions shared across canonical exchange rate models, leveraging their key insights while remaining robust to misspecification relative to structural models typically used in the literature. To sharpen the identification, sign restrictions are complemented with narrative restrictions anchored on episodes of well documented FX market dysfunction. Focusing on two emerging economies (Brazil and Chile), our estimates suggest that financial shocks account for about one third of UIP fluctuations, and contribute less than 10% to the variance of macro variables including output and inflation. While infrequent, when they do materialize, financial shocks trigger sharp declines in output, suggesting economically meaningful spillovers from frictions in currency markets to the real economy.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种符号叙事向量自回归方法，用于识别货币市场中的金融冲击。该方法施加了跨经典汇率模型共享的最小符号限制，利用其关键见解，同时相对于文献中通常使用的结构模型，对错误设定保持稳健性。为增强识别的精确性，符号限制辅以基于文献记载充分的汇率市场功能障碍事件的叙事限制。聚焦于两个新兴经济体（巴西和智利），我们的估计表明，金融冲击解释了约三分之一的未抛补利率平价波动，并对包括产出和通胀在内的宏观变量方差贡献不足10%。尽管这些冲击不频繁，但一旦发生，便会引发产出的急剧下降，暗示货币市场摩擦对实体经济具有经济意义上的显著溢出效应。

abstract: I use a randomized controlled trial to study how nonresident tuition affects where highly skilled workers eventually live and work. For every $10,000 of tuition relief, the university receives $1,903 from increased enrollment and loses $2,738 from reduced tuition, yielding a small $835 loss. Treated students are more likely to stay in-state 12 years later and eventually earn $25,302 more in present value within the local economy, showing that the university’s profit-maximizing tuition level is suboptimal from the state’s perspective. The effects are driven by higher retention of inframarginal students and by out-of-state US nationals rather than international students.
abstract_zh: 我采用随机对照试验，研究非居民学费如何影响高技能工人最终的生活与工作地点。每减免10,000美元学费，大学因入学人数增加获得1,903美元收益，但因学费降低损失2,738美元，净损失为835美元。受助学生更可能在12年后留在本州，并在当地经济中最终获得现值25,302美元的额外收入，这表明从州的角度看，大学追求利润最大化的学费水平并非最优。这些效应主要由边际内学生的更高留存率以及来自美国其他州而非国际学生所驱动。

title: Ambiguous Attribution: Theory and Evidence
title_zh: 模糊归因：理论与证据
title_primary: 模糊归因：理论与证据
title_secondary: Ambiguous Attribution: Theory and Evidence
authors: Ricardo Alonso, Monica Martinez-Bravo, Gerard Padró I Miquel, Carlos Sanz, Silvia Vannutelli
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Clarity of responsibility is an essential element of political accountability. We develop a rational model of Bayesian updating in the presence of ambiguous attribution and we test its predictions using an original survey. We show that respondents’ partisanship, assessment of public healthcare quality, and beliefs over which layer of government is responsible for healthcare are correlated as predicted: good-assessment voters attribute responsibility to the layer governed by their preferred party, while bad-assessment voters blame the layer governed by the party they dislike. These partisan patterns of credit and blame, often interpreted as evidence of motivated reasoning or partisan bias, can thus arise from rational Bayesian updating under attribution ambiguity. No such partisan patterns exist where the same party is in charge of regional and central government. A survey experiment in which we inform subjects of the official quality of healthcare has them update in the predicted, partisan, direction. Model and empirical results show that partisan priors are extremely hard to dislodge when attribution is ambiguous.
abstract_zh: 责任明确性是政治问责制的核心要素。我们构建了一个在归因模糊情境下进行贝叶斯更新的理性模型，并通过一项原创调查检验其预测。研究显示，受访者的党派立场、对公共医疗质量的评估，以及其对哪一层级政府负责医疗事务的信念，三者之间的相关性符合模型预测：评估良好的选民将责任归于其偏好政党所治理的层级，而评估不佳的选民则归咎于其不喜欢的政党所治理的层级。这种党派性的功劳与责备模式，常被解读为动机性推理或党派偏见的证据，但在归因模糊条件下，其亦可源于理性的贝叶斯更新。当同一政党同时掌控地区与中央政府时，此类党派模式则不复存在。在一项调查实验中，我们向受试者告知官方医疗质量信息，其更新方向符合预测的党派倾向。模型与实证结果表明，在归因模糊的情况下，党派先验信念极难被撼动。

official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Multinational firms tend to earn higher stock returns than purely domestic firms, raising questions about what drives their differential exposure to aggregate risk. This column presents evidence that firms run by CEOs with multinational expertise are more likely to expand abroad, and domestic firms that will go on to become multinationals carry higher risk premia before they even expand. The authors explain these patterns through a model that predicts that managerial ability amplifies the risk premia of domestic firms (through the option value of becoming multinational) while dampening the risk premia of multinationals (through operating leverage), and discuss the implications for tax policy.

abstract: We develop a multi-country, multi-sector New Keynesian model with incomplete markets, input-output linkages, and heterogeneous sectoral price rigidities to study the macroeconomic effects of tariffs. Tariffs act simultaneously as demand and supply shocks. A risk-sharing wedge, driven by terms-of-trade effects and revalued net foreign assets, summarizes the wealth transfer in general equilibrium and determines whether the tariff-imposing country gains or loses. This wedge interacts with a propagation matrix encoding network structure, sectoral rigidity, and cross-country monetary policy heterogeneity, which governs how inherited real marginal-cost distortions feed into inflation and consumption. Through input-output linkages, transitory tariffs generate persistent distortions, unlike standard New Keynesian benchmarks. These distortions exceed what N-country monetary policy can offset, even under flexible exchange rates. Quantitatively, the 2025-2026 tariffs are stagflationary for the U.S. and yield inflation or deflation abroad depending on trade diversion and monetary policy heterogeneity. Tariff threats alone generate inflation shaped by retaliation expectations.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含不完全市场、投入产出关联及异质性部门价格粘性的多国多部门新凯恩斯模型，用以研究关税的宏观经济效应。关税同时发挥需求冲击与供给冲击的作用。由贸易条件效应与重估后的净外国资产驱动的风险分担楔子，概括了一般均衡中的财富转移，并决定了征收关税国家的损益状况。该楔子与一个编码了网络结构、部门粘性及跨国货币政策异质性的传播矩阵相互作用，后者决定了继承的实际边际成本扭曲如何传导至通胀与消费。通过投入产出关联，临时性关税会产生持续性扭曲，这与标准新凯恩斯基准模型不同。即便在浮动汇率制度下，这些扭曲也超出了N国货币政策所能抵消的范围。定量分析表明，2025-2026年关税对美国具有滞胀效应，并根据贸易转移与货币政策异质性导致国外通胀或通缩。仅关税威胁本身就会产生由报复预期塑造的通胀。

abstract: This paper tests the insiders? dilemma hypothesis in a laboratory experiment. The insiders? dilemma means that a profitable merger does not occur, because it is even more profitable for each firm to unilaterally stand as an outsider (Stigler, 1950; Kamien and Zang, 1990 and 1993). The experimental data provides support for the insiders? dilemma, and thereby for endogenous rather than exogenous merger theory. More surprisingly, our data suggests that fairness (or relative performance) considerations also make profitable mergers difficult. Mergers that should occur in equilibrium do not, since they require an unequal split of surplus.
abstract_zh: 本文通过实验室实验检验了内部人困境假说。内部人困境是指一项有利可图的合并未能发生，因为每个企业单方面作为局外人反而能获得更高利润（Stigler, 1950; Kamien and Zang, 1990, 1993）。实验数据支持内部人困境的存在，从而验证了内生性合并理论而非外生性合并理论。更令人意外的是，我们的数据表明，公平性（或相对绩效）考量同样阻碍了有利可图的合并。本应在均衡状态下发生的合并未能实现，原因在于这些合并要求对剩余进行不平等分配。

abstract: We develop two proposals to enhance the prospects for both liberalization of services trade and regulatory reform. The first is for governments to create mechanisms ('services knowledge platforms') to bring together regulators, trade officials and stakeholders to discuss services regulatory reform. Such mechanisms could identify reform priorities and opportunities for utilization of 'aid for trade' resources, thereby putting in place the preconditions for future market opening. The second proposal is for a new approach to negotiations in the WTO, with a critical mass of countries that account for the bulk of services production agreeing to lock-in applied levels of protection and pre-committing to reform of policies affecting FDI and international movement for individual service providers--two areas where current policy is most restrictive and potential benefits from liberalization are greatest. If these proposals cannot be fully implemented in the Doha time frame, then any Doha agreement could at least lay the basis for a forward-looking program of international cooperation along the proposed lines.
abstract_zh: 我们提出两项建议，以提升服务贸易自由化与监管改革的前景。第一项建议是，各国政府应建立机制（“服务知识平台”），将监管机构、贸易官员和利益相关方聚集在一起，讨论服务监管改革。此类机制可确定改革优先事项及利用“贸易援助”资源的机会，从而为未来的市场开放奠定前提条件。第二项建议是针对世贸组织谈判采取新方法，由占服务生产绝大部分的关键国家群体同意锁定现行保护水平，并预先承诺改革影响外国直接投资和个体服务提供者国际流动的政策——这两个领域当前政策限制最为严格，而自由化的潜在收益也最大。如果这些建议无法在多哈回合时间框架内完全实施，那么任何多哈协议至少可为按照上述方向开展前瞻性国际合作计划奠定基础。

abstract: U.S. policy increasingly seeks to slow China's technological rise by restricting its access to American science, on the assumption that Chinese innovation depends on U.S. science. Linking the full corpus of Chinese invention patents to the global scientific literature, we show that this dependence has fallen in recent years: the share of the China-produced science behind Chinese patents rose from 1% in 2000 to 26% in 2025, overtaking the U.S. share in 2021. As China's reliance on U.S.-produced science fades, policies restricting access fall out of alignment with the U.S.' actual strategic position.

abstract: Women are underrepresented in patenting. In this study, we consider differential responsiveness to rejection as a contributor to the gender gap in invention. Leveraging the prosecution histories of almost one million U.S. patent applications and the quasirandom assignment of applications to examiners, we show that women are 3.6–6.9 percentage points less likely to continue in the application process following an early-stage rejection. Conditional on applying for a patent, male-female disparities in the propensity to abandon applications account for more than half of the overall gender gap in issued patents. We provide suggestive evidence that institutional support can help reduce the attrition gap.

abstract: 提升创业投资集聚程度是优化科技型中小企业融资环境,推进金融服务科技创新能力建设的关键举措。本文构建一个嵌入创业投资的内生增长模型,利用基金小镇设立的外生冲击分析创业投资集聚对企业创新的影响。研究发现,创业投资集聚能够改善研发资金配置效率,显著提升企业创新产出。机制分析表明,信息搜寻成本和委托代理成本下降是其激励企业创新的主要渠道,具体表现为在基金小镇设立后,被投资企业获取了充足的外部融资,创业投资机构参与企业内部治理的概率提升。进一步研究发现,地区营商环境是决定创业投资集聚外部性强弱的关键因素。本文研究结论为壮大耐心资本和因地制宜培育新质生产力提供了坚实的理论支撑和经验证据。

abstract: Lipscomb, Mobarak, and Barham (2013) document large positive effects of electrification in Brazil due to broad-based improvements in labor productivity. They instrument electrification by simulating a hypothetical power grid roll-out driven solely by geographic factors. Their estimates are not robust to repeated runs of the simulation, which in most cases lead to weak instruments. Furthermore, removing coding errors turns the main outcomes and most originally identified mechanisms statistically insignificant in most of the repeated runs, even when using a specification proposed in a corrigendum published by the original authors.
abstract_zh: Lipscomb、Mobarak和Barham（2013）的研究表明，巴西电气化因劳动生产率的广泛提升而产生了显著的正面效应。他们通过模拟仅由地理因素驱动的假设性电网扩展来对电气化进行工具变量估计。然而，其估计结果在重复模拟中并不稳健，多数情况下会导致弱工具变量问题。此外，即使采用原作者在勘误中提出的设定，修正编码错误后，在大多数重复模拟中，主要结果及最初识别的多数机制在统计上均不再显著。

authors: Thomas Baudin, Robert Stelter
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: European fascist regimes have attached great importance to nationalistic families and designed policies to perpetuate them. Most offered policy packages with interest-free loans repayable through childbirth, along with allowances and tax deductions for large families. Using a difference-in-difference approach and Nazi Germany as a case study, we show that these policies may have counterproductive effects due to negative selection mechanisms in the marriage market. The excessive pressure to marry exerted on singles results in lower quality, ultimately less fertile, and more fragile unions. This finding is important as the main European far-right parties today propose reinstating these policy packages.
abstract_zh: 欧洲法西斯政权高度重视民族主义家庭，并制定了旨在延续这些家庭的政策。多数政权提供了一揽子政策，包括通过生育偿还的无息贷款，以及对大家庭的补贴和税收减免。本文以纳粹德国为案例，采用双重差分法研究发现，由于婚姻市场中的负向选择机制，这些政策可能产生适得其反的效果。对单身者施加的过度婚姻压力导致婚姻质量下降，最终形成生育率更低、关系更脆弱的结合。这一发现具有重要意义，因为当今欧洲主要极右翼政党正提议重新推行此类政策组合。

title: Congestion Pricing and Emergency Medical Service Response: Evidence from New York City
title_zh: 拥堵收费与紧急医疗服务响应：来自纽约市的证据

authors: Chikish, Yulia, Colman, Gregory, Dave, Dhaval, Humphreys, Brad R., Santamaria, Zachary 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Large cities worldwide have adopted congestion pricing to reduce urban traffic, with well-documented benefits for travel speeds, accident rates, and air quality. This paper identifies a novel external benefit: faster emergency medical service (EMS) response times. We provide the first evidence on how the congestion pricing program in New York City – the first comprehensive cordon-based congestion pricing system in the U.S. that was implemented on January 5th, 2025 – affects EMS performance. Exploiting the sharp geographic boundary of New York City’s congestion relief zone at 60th Street and a difference-in-discontinuities design, we first document substantial changes in traffic and mobility near the boundary: vehicular traffic declines by roughly 18 to 21 percent, accompanied by increases in pedestrian and bicycle activity. Consistent with these first-stage mechanisms, we find that congestion pricing improves EMS performance, reducing total travel times by 63–70 seconds (approximately 5–6 percent). Effects emerged quickly and show little evidence of displacement to adjacent areas. A concurrent FDNY directive requiring transport to the nearest hospital confounds standard difference-in-differences estimates but not our boundary-based design. These findings suggest that cost-benefit analyses of congestion pricing systematically understate net social benefits by omitting emergency response improvements.
abstract_zh: 全球各大城市已普遍采用拥堵收费政策以减少城市交通拥堵，其在提升通行速度、降低事故率及改善空气质量方面的效益已有充分文献佐证。本文识别出一项新型外部效益：急救医疗服务响应时间的缩短。我们首次提供了关于纽约市拥堵收费计划——美国首个于2025年1月5日实施的综合性区域拥堵收费系统——如何影响急救医疗服务绩效的证据。利用纽约市拥堵缓解区在第60街的清晰地理边界及断点回归设计，我们首先记录了边界附近交通与出行模式的显著变化：机动车流量下降约18%至21%，同时伴随步行与自行车活动的增加。与这些第一阶段机制相一致，我们发现拥堵收费改善了急救医疗服务绩效，将总行程时间缩短63至70秒（约5%至6%）。该效应迅速显现，且几乎没有证据表明其向邻近区域转移。纽约市消防局同时实施的将患者送往最近医院的指令混淆了传统双重差分估计结果，但未影响基于边界的识别设计。这些发现表明，拥堵收费的成本效益分析因忽略应急响应改善而系统性低估了净社会效益。

title: Forecasting with Uncertain Persistence

authors: Joel P. Flynn, Maksim Meinert, Karthik Sastry
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: With uncertainty about persistence, we show that forecasts necessarily become more persistent and over-react at long horizons. For these reasons, correctly specified and Bayesian forecasts may under-react at short horizons and over-react at long horizons. These results provide a unified explanation for several asset pricing and forecasting puzzles, including: (i) the excess responsiveness of long-horizon rates to short rates, (ii) the dominance of apparent term premia for long-term rates, (iii) the ex post predictability of bond yields, (iv) the excess volatility of long-horizon forward prices, (v) the excess persistence of long-horizon forecasts, and (vi) the over-reaction of long-horizon forecasts.
abstract_zh: 在存在持续性不确定性的情况下，我们证明预测必然变得更加持久，并在长期范围内过度反应。基于这些原因，正确设定的贝叶斯预测可能在短期范围内反应不足，而在长期范围内过度反应。这些结果为多个资产定价与预测谜题提供了统一解释，包括：（i）长期利率对短期利率的过度响应，（ii）长期利率中显性期限溢价的支配地位，（iii）债券收益率的后验可预测性，（iv）长期远期价格的过度波动，（v）长期预测的过度持续性，以及（vi）长期预测的过度反应。

abstract: Many real-world negotiations are persistently delayed, yet imposing deadlines is costly because it induces inefficient separations. Do all deadlines in one-on-one market transactions need to be perfectly credible? To improve trade efficiency, I propose a mechanism that introduces an intermediate, imperfectly credible deadline to facilitate agreement. Using a canonical seller–buyer dynamic bargaining model with a credible deadline, I analytically characterize the optimal degree of credibility of such a deadline that maximizes trade efficiency, leading to early agreements without triggering separations. Under a non-zero risk of separation, the seller is tempted to discount the price to secure a payoff, while the buyer is more likely to accept at the intermediate deadline because pricing resembles ultimatum offers. A laboratory experiment provides direct evidence of the mechanism’s effects that extend beyond the theoretical benchmark.
abstract_zh: 许多现实世界中的谈判常常被持续拖延，然而设定截止日期成本高昂，因为它会导致效率低下的分离。一对一市场交易中的所有截止日期是否都必须完全可信？为了提升交易效率，我提出了一种机制，引入一个中间程度的、不完全可信的截止日期来促进协议达成。利用一个带有可信截止日期的经典卖方-买方动态讨价还价模型，我从分析上刻画了此类截止日期的最优可信度，以最大化交易效率，从而在不引发分离的情况下促成早期协议。在存在非零分离风险的情况下，卖方倾向于降低价格以确保收益，而买方则更可能在中间截止日期接受，因为定价类似于最后通牒式报价。一项实验室实验提供了该机制效果的直接证据，这些效果超出了理论基准的预期。

abstract: How does informality shape the impact of minimum wage policy? We study this question using evidence from Mexico’s 145% real increase in the minimum wage since 2016, together with a general equilibrium model featuring endogenous informality and household heterogeneity. Reduced-form estimates of the implemented increases indicate limited effects on employment and formalization, alongside modest wage gains at the bottom of the formal wage distribution that arguably reflect incomplete enforcement. The calibrated model reproduces these patterns but predicts that, under full enforcement, higher wage floors generate nonlinear effects: the share of firms reallocating toward informality rises sharply, lowering productivity and aggregate welfare. These losses fall disproportionately on low-skill households, who bear the brunt of the reduction in transfers caused by lower tax revenue yet, as predominantly informal workers, gain little directly from the minimum wage. The minimum wage’s effectiveness as a redistributive tool is therefore limited.
abstract_zh: 非正规性如何影响最低工资政策的效果？我们利用墨西哥自2016年以来最低工资实际增长145%的证据，结合包含内生非正规性与家庭异质性的一般均衡模型来研究这一问题。对已实施最低工资上调的简化形式估计表明，其对就业和正规化的影响有限，同时正规工资分布底端出现温和的工资增长——这在一定程度上反映了执法不完善。校准后的模型复现了这些特征，但预测在完全执法条件下，更高的工资下限会产生非线性效应：转向非正规部门的企业比例急剧上升，从而降低生产率和总体福利。这些损失不成比例地由低技能家庭承担——他们因税收减少导致的转移支付下降而首当其冲，但作为以非正规就业为主的劳动者，却几乎无法直接从最低工资中获益。因此，最低工资作为再分配工具的有效性十分有限。

abstract: Data centers now account for 4.4% of United States electricity demand, yet the grid-level effectiveness of the renewable energy certificates (RECs) and power purchase agreements (PPAs) hyperscalers use to claim carbon neutrality remains unclear. We develop a game-theoretic model in which a data center operator chooses among RECs, PPAs, and behind-the-meter colocation while generators make entry decisions under endogenous financing costs. The model identifies a timing wedge -- the mismatch between consumption and credited renewable generation -- as a central mechanism through which AI demand degrades reliability, raises prices, and increases emissions even when RECs cover 100% of annual consumption. Colocation with storage addresses this wedge directly and induces the greatest renewable entry by eliminating generator revenue risk. We test these predictions by exploiting the staggered release of large language models as a natural experiment, using difference-in-differences on a novel dataset linking AI activity to local grid outcomes. AI demand significantly increases fossil generation, wholesale prices (up to 25% in treated PJM zones), and outage frequency (0.5--1 additional outages per year) near data centers, with impacts scaling in model size. Data centers with on-site generation exhibit a sign reversal in power-quality effects, consistent with the model's prediction that behind-the-meter capacity absorbs demand spikes. Counterfactual analyses show that edge inference, spatial reallocation, and colocated storage each substantially mitigate grid impacts, while REC-only strategies do not. Together, our results demonstrate that the externalities of AI to the grid are tightly coupled to procurement design and the spatial organization of data center infrastructure.
abstract_zh: 数据中心目前占美国电力需求的4.4%，然而，超大规模企业用于宣称碳中和的可再生能源证书（RECs）和购电协议（PPAs）在电网层面的有效性仍不明确。我们构建了一个博弈论模型，其中数据中心运营商在RECs、PPAs和表后共置方案之间进行选择，而发电商则在内生融资成本下做出进入决策。该模型识别出一个时间错配——即电力消费与可归因的可再生能源发电之间的时间差——作为核心机制，通过这一机制，即使RECs覆盖100%的年度消费，人工智能需求仍会降低电网可靠性、推高电价并增加碳排放。与储能设施共置直接解决了这一时间错配问题，并通过消除发电商的收入风险，最大程度地促进了可再生能源的进入。我们利用大语言模型的分阶段发布作为自然实验，通过双重差分法对连接人工智能活动与地方电网结果的新数据集进行检验，以验证这些预测。人工智能需求显著增加了数据中心附近化石燃料发电量、批发电价（在受影响的PJM区域最高上涨25%）以及停电频率（每年额外增加0.5至1次停电），且影响程度随模型规模扩大而增强。配备自备发电设施的数据中心在电能质量效应上表现出符号反转，这与模型预测一致，即表后容量能够吸收需求尖峰。反事实分析表明，边缘推理、空间重新布局以及共置储能均能显著缓解电网影响，而仅依赖RECs的策略则无法实现。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，人工智能对电网的外部性与采购设计及数据中心基础设施的空间组织紧密相关。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Digital platforms allocate buyer attention across sellers that differ in quality and breadth of appeal. We study a monopoly platform that sets meeting rates between buyers and two seller types --- niche sellers whose high-quality good is valued by a fraction of buyers and mass-market sellers whose good is valued by all. Sellers compete by posting prices à la Burdett and Judd (1983), so buyer surplus requires competition, while platform revenue requires seller rents. This difference creates a systematic distortion: as search capacity grows, the platform keeps high-quality niche attention just past the point where extra exposure stops creating rents and starts eroding them — its saturation point — and diverts the rest to mass-market sellers. The resulting buyer-surplus loss converges to a finite limit proportional to the quality gap between the two goods, split equally between an allocative loss from too little high-quality exposure and excess rent extracted by sellers. Applying the model to Amazon product search and Google passage-ranking data indicates that, for captive buyers, both platforms operate past the saturation point, with buyer-surplus losses of 63 and 44 percent of the planner's benchmark, respectively. Allowing buyer participation to respond to the platform's recommendation strategy disciplines the platform and shrinks this loss.
abstract_zh: 数字平台在质量与吸引力广度各异的卖家之间分配买家注意力。我们研究了一个垄断平台，该平台设定买家与两类卖家之间的匹配率——利基卖家（其高质量商品仅被部分买家青睐）与大众市场卖家（其商品被所有买家青睐）。卖家按照Burdett和Judd（1983）的模型进行价格竞争，因此买家剩余依赖于竞争，而平台收入则依赖于卖家租金。这一差异造成了系统性扭曲：随着搜索能力的增长，平台将高质量利基卖家的注意力维持在刚好超过额外曝光不再创造租金、反而开始侵蚀租金的临界点——即其饱和点——并将剩余注意力转移给大众市场卖家。由此导致的买家剩余损失收敛于一个有限极限，该极限与两种商品的质量差距成正比，并均分为两部分：高质量曝光不足造成的配置损失，以及卖家攫取的超额租金。将该模型应用于亚马逊产品搜索与谷歌段落排名数据后发现，对于被锁定的买家而言，两个平台的运营均已超过饱和点，买家剩余损失分别达到规划者基准水平的63%和44%。允许买家参与度对平台推荐策略做出反应，能够约束平台行为并缩小这一损失。

abstract: This paper examines the credit supply effects of sale-of-business (SoB) bank resolutions under the post-Global Financial Crisis regulatory framework, focusing on the resolution of a major Spanish bank. We provide the first micro-level evidence of how an SoB resolution reshapes credit allocation. The acquiring bank preserved lending relationships, prioritizing support for riskier inherited borrowers most exposed to competing banks' retrenchment. This stabilization was achieved despite tighter capital conditions, as the acquiring bank strategically reallocated credit within its broader portfolio, shifting away from more capital-intensive exposures.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了后全球金融危机监管框架下业务出售型银行处置的信贷供给效应，重点关注一家西班牙大型银行的处置案例。我们首次提供了微观层面证据，揭示业务出售型处置如何重塑信贷配置。收购方银行保留了借贷关系，优先支持那些面临其他银行收缩信贷时风险敞口最大的继承借款人。尽管资本条件趋紧，收购方银行仍通过在其更广泛的资产组合中战略性重新配置信贷（减少资本密集型敞口）实现了这一稳定效应。

abstract: This paper proposes a correlated random coefficient linear panel data model, where regressors can be correlated with time-varying and individual-specific random coefficients through both a fixed effect and a time-varying random shock. I develop a new panel data-based method to identify the average partial effect and the local average response function. The identification strategy employs a sufficient statistic to control for the fixed effect and a control variable for the random shock. Conditional on these two controls, the residual variation in the regressors is driven solely by the exogenous instrumental variables, and thus can be exploited to identify the parameters of interest. The constructive identification analysis leads to three-step series estimators, for which I establish rates of convergence and asymptotic normality. To illustrate the method, I estimate a heterogeneous Cobb-Douglas production function for manufacturing firms in China, finding substantial variations in output elasticities across firms that can be related to various firm characteristics.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种相关随机系数线性面板数据模型，其中回归元可通过固定效应和时变随机冲击与个体特定的时变随机系数相关。我开发了一种基于面板数据的新方法，以识别平均部分效应和局部平均响应函数。识别策略利用一个充分统计量来控制固定效应，并采用一个控制变量来处理随机冲击。在这两个控制条件下，回归元中的剩余变异仅由外生工具变量驱动，因此可用于识别感兴趣参数。构造性识别分析导出了三步级数估计量，我为其建立了收敛速率和渐近正态性。为说明该方法，我估计了中国制造业企业的异质性柯布-道格拉斯生产函数，发现企业间产出弹性存在显著差异，且这些差异可与企业特征相关联。

abstract: This paper uses five rounds of Mexican and Brazilian census extracts to evaluate the accuracy of different model specifications and estimation methods that use survey and census data to generate small area estimates of poverty. Models that utilize more granular data for prediction (household- and/or village-level predictors) tend to produce more accurate estimates of poverty than models estimated only using area-level predictors. Differences in accuracy across models and methods that utilize household or village level predictors are minor. Models that omit household-level predictors tend to be more robust than unit-level models to the use of old census data and classical measurement error in survey predictors. The performance of the Fay-Herriot area-level model falls in the presence of sample selection bias and small sample sizes. Rescaling sample weights is important in Mexico, where the sample is informative within areas. Applying raw sample weights without rescaling in this case greatly reduces the accuracy of estimates from linear models and distorts methodological comparisons. Overall, no one approach dominates across all contexts, but when sample weights are rescaled there is no downside to using more granular data for prediction.
abstract_zh: 本文利用墨西哥和巴西五轮人口普查数据，评估了不同模型设定及估计方法（结合调查与普查数据生成贫困小区域估计值）的准确性。相较于仅使用区域层面预测变量的模型，采用更细粒度数据（家庭层面和/或村庄层面预测变量）进行预测的模型往往能生成更准确的贫困估计值。在利用家庭或村庄层面预测变量的模型与方法之间，其准确性差异较小。省略家庭层面预测变量的模型在使用旧普查数据及调查预测变量存在经典测量误差时，通常比单元层面模型更具稳健性。Fay-Herriot区域层面模型在样本选择偏差和小样本量情况下表现下降。在墨西哥，由于样本在区域内具有信息性，重新调整样本权重至关重要。若在此情况下直接使用未经调整的原始样本权重，将大幅降低线性模型估计值的准确性，并扭曲方法比较结果。总体而言，没有任何一种方法在所有情境下均占优，但当样本权重经过重新调整后，使用更细粒度数据进行预测不会产生负面影响。

abstract: ABSTRACT Within the EU and beyond, voluntary agri‐environmental and climate schemes (AES) are used to curtail externalities from agricultural production including nitrate leaching, biodiversity degradation and greenhouse gas emissions. This paper investigates and compares Danish landowners' preferences for temporary and permanent AES using a choice experiment (CE). We focus on landowners, who are the decision makers in terms of permanent land use change. Our study focuses on two land set‐aside contracts: temporary with annual payments and permanent with a lump‐sum payment. Results reveal that landowners require higher compensation if AES design implies giving up direct subsidy payments and hunting rights under both permanent and temporary set aside schemes. Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) direct payments were valued lower in the presence of the CAP agricultural activity requirement in permanent contracts compared to a situation without an activity requirement. As expected, landowners require higher compensation for longer commitments in temporary schemes and for rewetting commitments in permanent schemes. The average implied discount rate for schemes that mirror actual annual and lump‐sum permanent schemes offered to farmers in Denmark is 3.3%–3.4%, while that based on the CE is 1.9%–2.1%. Comparing implicit discount rates of hypothetical CE schemes with current Danish AES highlights a significant policy design misalignment. The implication is that current policy favours flexible annual payments, while the societal benefits from permanent schemes are arguably higher.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在欧盟及其他地区，自愿性农业环境与气候计划（AES）被用于遏制农业生产带来的外部性，包括硝酸盐淋溶、生物多样性退化及温室气体排放。本文通过选择实验（CE）调查并比较了丹麦土地所有者对临时性和永久性AES的偏好。我们重点关注土地所有者，他们是永久性土地利用变化的决策者。本研究聚焦于两种土地休耕合同：临时性合同采用年度支付，永久性合同采用一次性支付。结果显示，若AES设计涉及放弃直接补贴支付和狩猎权，土地所有者在永久性和临时性休耕计划下均要求更高的补偿。在永久性合同中，存在共同农业政策（CAP）农业活动要求时，CAP直接支付的价值低于无活动要求的情况。如预期所料，土地所有者对临时性计划中更长的承诺期及永久性计划中的再湿润承诺要求更高的补偿。对于与丹麦农民实际提供的年度和一次性永久性计划相对应的方案，平均隐含贴现率为3.3%–3.4%，而基于CE的贴现率为1.9%–2.1%。将假设性CE方案的隐含贴现率与当前丹麦AES进行比较，揭示了显著的政策设计错位。其含义在于，当前政策偏向于灵活的年度支付，而永久性计划的社会效益可能更高。

abstract: We investigate the sources of the dealer centrality premium in the over-the-counter market for corporate bonds. We model dealer heterogeneity by allowing the dealer's status in the network to determine search effort and inventory costs when choosing to conduct riskless principal or principal trades. Structural estimates match the observed centrality premium across transaction types and trade count deciles. Counterfactual analyses reveal that measures that limit core dealer bargaining power vis-a-vis clients reduce roundtrip spreads. Removing core dealers' advantage in search relative to peripheral dealers has little effect on transaction costs.
abstract_zh: 我们探究了公司债券场外交易市场中交易商中心性溢价的来源。通过允许交易商在网络中的地位决定其选择进行无风险本金交易或本金交易时的搜索努力和库存成本，我们对交易商异质性进行了建模。结构估计结果与观察到的不同交易类型及交易次数十分位上的中心性溢价相吻合。反事实分析显示，限制核心交易商相对于客户的议价能力的措施会降低往返价差。而消除核心交易商相对于外围交易商在搜索方面的优势，对交易成本影响甚微。

abstract: We introduce a novel Bayesian framework for estimating time-varying volatility by extending the Random Walk Stochastic Volatility (RWSV) model with Dynamic Shrinkage Processes (DSP) in log-variances. Unlike the classical Stochastic Volatility (SV) or GARCH-type models with restrictive parametric stationarity assumptions, our proposed Adaptive Stochastic Volatility (ASV) model provides smooth yet dynamically adaptive estimates of evolving volatility and its uncertainty. We further enhance the model by incorporating a nugget effect, allowing it to flexibly capture small-scale variability while preserving smoothness elsewhere. We derive the theoretical properties of the global-local shrinkage prior DSP. Simulation studies demonstrate that ASV is highly robust to misspecification, consistently recovering the latent volatility structure across a wide range of data-generating processes. Furthermore, ASV’s capacity to yield locally smooth and interpretable estimates facilitates a clearer understanding of the underlying patterns and trends in volatility. As an extension, we develop the Bayesian Trend Filter with ASV (BTF-ASV) which allows joint modeling of the mean and volatility with abrupt changes. Finally, our proposed models are applied to time series data from finance, econometrics, and environmental science, highlighting their flexibility and broad applicability.

abstract: Economic analysis based on text data has expanded rapidly, yet the ultra-high dimensionality of text data presents substantial challenges for term selection and estimation. We propose the Information-Adaptive Lasso and Information-Adaptive Spike-and-Slab Lasso as novel frequentist and Bayesian approaches to address these challenges. A key theoretical contribution of this study is the establishment of the rate of convergence in term-selection consistency, which we show to be faster than those achieved in the existing Lasso literature. Applying our methods to Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) statements, we identify and estimate high-impact terms driving fluctuations in monetary policy uncertainty.

title: The impact of fiscal transparency on the spatial layout of enterprises: evidence from China

abstract: This study examines the impact of fiscal transparency on the spatial layout of enterprises. After collecting data on 36,285 off-site subsidiaries established by 3725 listed companies in China’s A-share market from 2014 to 2021 and using the conditional logit model for empirical analysis, it is found that listed companies have a higher probability of establishing subsidiaries in cities with higher fiscal transparency. The above effect is more pronounced in the site selection process of subsidiaries that are affiliated with privately owned parent companies or not directly held by their parent companies, as well as micro, small, and medium-sized subsidiaries and subsidiaries whose main business is in the financial or real estate industry. To better attract capital inflows, local governments should enhance their information disclosure systems to improve fiscal transparency, strengthen communication with enterprises, and implement differentiated policies tailored to various types of enterprises.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨财政透明度对企业空间布局的影响。通过收集2014年至2021年间中国A股市场3725家上市公司设立的36285家异地子公司数据，并运用条件Logit模型进行实证分析，发现上市公司更倾向于在财政透明度较高的城市设立子公司。上述效应在私营母公司下属或非直接控股的子公司选址过程中更为显著，同时，在微型、小型及中型子公司以及主营业务涉及金融或房地产行业的子公司中表现尤为突出。为更好地吸引资本流入，地方政府应完善信息披露制度以提升财政透明度，加强与企业的沟通，并针对不同类型企业实施差异化政策。
